**Senior Development Engineer, VELUX Products & Innovation – Maintenance Free Window Modules – LKR Innovation House - Østbirk

****Join a team of passionate engineers and technical specialists with end-to-end responsibility for critical window modules. If you thrive on solving complex technical challenges, driving product development, and creating value across the entire product lifecycle, you could be our next Senior Development Engineer.

****Meet your future team

**You will become part of the Maintenance Free Window Modules team based in Østbirk. The team has end-to-end responsibility for VELUX sash and frame mo-dules made from polyurethane and other polymers, as well as our Insulating Glass Unit (IGU) modules.

Working across the full product lifecycle, the team supports everything from concept creation and new product introduction to continuous optimization of cost, performance, sustainability, and quality. We collaborate closely with Product Management, Production, and other development teams to ensure our products continue to create value for customers and the business.

As our new Senior Development Engineer, you will act as the Module Owner of the IGU module area, driving development activities, shaping future module roadmaps, and ensuring strong cross-functional alignment across the organization.

**What We Offer

**This is an opportunity to take on a highly influential technical role with significant impact across products, processes, and stakeholders. You will work with experienced colleagues in an international environment where innovation, knowledge sharing, and collaboration are valued and encouraged.

More specifically your tasks will be to:

• Hold technical ownership and end-to-end responsibility for Insulating Glass Unit (IGU) modules.

• Drive module development activities across new product launches, performance improvements, cost optimization, upgrades, sustainability initiatives, and quality enhancements.

• Conduct module health assessments to evaluate performance, value creation, business relevance, and future opportunities.

• Identify, qualify, and drive opportunities that create value across the product lifecycle and value chain.

• Lead design, concept development, and resolution of complex technical challenges.

• Define and secure technical requirements, module performance, and robust engineering solutions.

• Build strong relationships with stakeholders and ensure alignment across Product Management, Production, Supply Chain, and Product Development.

• Support management decision-making through technical expertise and insights.

• Act as a knowledge leader by developing technical capabilities, facilitating learning activities, and promoting effective knowledge sharing throughout the organization.

**What You Will Bring

**You enjoy navigating complex technical environments and are motivated by combining deep technical expertise with cross-functional collaboration. You take ownership, communicate clearly, and are able to balance technical excellence with business value.

Moreover, we expect that you:

• Hold a Master’s degree in Engineering or another relevant technical discipline.

• Have experience working with product development or complex technical products.

• Possess strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a structured approach to technical challenges.

• Have experience with CAD tools, preferably CREO and Windchill.

• Communicate fluently in English, both verbally and in writing.

• Demonstrate the ability to engage and align stakeholders across functions and disciplines.

• Take a proactive approach and can independently drive activities from concept to implementation.

• Have experience or knowledge into systems engineering, which is considered an advantage but not a requirement.

• Have experience or knowledge within insulating glass, glazing solutions, or related technologies, which is considered an advantage but not a requirement.

**Ready to apply?

**Learn more about the VELUX Group online at www.velux.com where you can read more about working at our company and what to expect of our recruitment process.

We look forward to receiving your application and CV as soon as possible. We are conducting interviews on an ongoing basis until we have found the right match.

All inquiries will be treated confidentially.

**About VELUX

**In the VELUX Group, we offer you a world of opportunities and the chance to create a bright future. From the forefront of the roof window category, we enable those who live, work and play under the roof transform their spaces and live a healthier everyday life with more daylight and fresh air.

The VELUX Group is an international, family-owned business with strong financial roots and each year we can create real impact by reinvesting in society, our employees and planet through our foundations. With 20 production companies in 12 countries and sales companies in 37 countries, our products are widely available. We employ around 12,000 people, and our company is headquartered in Denmark. Alongside the rest of our values, courage and mutual respect define our actions every day and how we wish to contribute to the world.

**Equal Opportunity Employer

**At VELUX Residential, we believe in fostering a diverse workplace for everyone to thrive, develop, and perform at their best, and where you feel welcome, respected, and valued. We are committed to providing equal opportunities for all, whether you are applying for a role or already a part of VELUX Residential. That means we recruit, hire, train, and promote people based on their skills and potential without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, neurodiversity, disability, protected veteran status, national origin, sexual orientation, or any other basis prohibited by applicable law.

We value diversity and strive to ensure that our employment decisions are fair and inclusive, focusing only on what truly matters: your qualifications and how you can contribute to our shared mission and success.

Are you ready to drive finance-critical IT projects at the heart of ALK's journey to SAP S/4HANA — shaping how a global pharmaceutical company runs its finance reporting and analytics?

About ALK

ALK's aspiration is to become the world leader in allergy by helping as many people as possible with allergy to a better life by providing options of prevention, diagnosis, and treatment of allergy. In Global IT, we contribute to this aspiration by supporting the organization with modern IT tools and digitalisation technologies, and by delivering world-class support to our many colleagues around the world.

The Role

As a Senior IT Project Manager at ALK, you will lead important finance-related IT initiatives from inception to execution, with a central role in our S/4HANA journey. You are first and foremost a strong project manager and facilitator who can guide the business through change. Your tasks will include:

• Ensuring timely, on-budget project delivery and successful milestone achievement.

• Aligning project outcomes with the strategic vision of the business.

• Coordinating internal and third-party resources effectively.

• Facilitating workshops and supporting the business through the change process.

• Driving finance projects with an emphasis on reporting, analytics and data modelling — including the redesign of our BW setup — alongside the connected changes across the core finance ERP.

• Steering the relationship with the Steering Committee and Project Group towards collaborative success.

Being structured, organized and proactive, you will anticipate issues before they arise and know when to involve the right people at the right time.

This role is based at our headquarters in Hørsholm, Denmark, where you will work closely with the hiring manager and senior finance leadership. As our SAP team is located in Madrid and much of the finance team sits in Kraków, you can expect regular travel to both locations.

What We're Seeking

We are on the lookout for a candidate with:

• A master’s degree in engineering, business or relevant fields.

• Proven experience in IT project management, ideally with finance, reporting or analytics projects.

• Strong stakeholder management and workshop facilitation skills, and the ability to support a business through change.

• A structured, organized and proactive working style.

• Familiarity with SAP, S/4HANA and BW/data modelling — you don't need to be an expert, but you should be comfortable operating in this landscape and speaking with the specialists. Having already been part of an S/4HANA journey is a strong advantage.

• Willingness to travel internationally, primarily to Madrid and Kraków.

• Fluency in English, both written and spoken.

• Familiarity with GxP pharma environments is desirable, but not mandatory.

Why ALK Global IT?

ALK's IT division is a robust team of approximately 150 professionals with IT hubs in Hørsholm, Madrid, Kraków, and with employees throughout our production and sales networks in Germany, France, North America and China. We prioritize professional growth and learning, valuing competency and knowledge exchange over formalities and encouraging a collaborative spirit every day.

Become a part of ALK

ALK provides a dynamic and accommodating work environment, complete with inspiring and challenging assignments. You are able to actively influence and challenge the status quo. Our flat structures attract independent individuals who like to feel the progress of the business and enjoy being close to the decision-making process.

We operate production sites in Denmark, France, Spain, and the United States, with a global team of approximately 2,800 employees. Our headquarters is located in the scenic DTU Science Park in Hørsholm, Denmark, which will be your primary workplace for this role.

Join us at ALK and be a part of an organization that values integrity, innovation, and making a difference in the lives of those we serve.

**Join Group Treasury at our headquarters in Faxe

**As part of our Group Treasury team, you will play a central role in managing the Group's treasury activities and supporting strategic financial decision-making. The Group Treasury-team reports directly to Executive Management and works closely with other headquarters functions, subsidiaries, and our Shared Service Centre in Lithuania. The position is based at our headquarters in Faxe.

**A Key Role with Broad Responsibility

****Responsibilities

**As Treasury Manager, you will work across a wide range of treasury disciplines, combining operational execution with strategic analysis. Your responsibilities will include:

• Preparing and maintaining the weekly Group cash flow forecast, including follow-up with subsidiaries to support liquidity planning and working capital initiatives.

• Managing Group cash management activities, including daily optimization of liquidity positions and continuous development of the Group's banking structure.

• Monitoring and reporting financial risks, including foreign exchange, commodity, and interest rate exposures, and providing hedging recommendations in line with the Group Treasury Policy.

• Executing transactions in aluminum, gas, foreign exchange, and interest rate swaps.

• Preparing and reporting the Group's financial items on a monthly, quarterly, and annual basis.

• Conducting ad hoc analyses related to financial risks, bank debt, performance, and other treasury-related topics.

• Supporting the management of the Group's insurance program.

In addition, you will act as a trusted financial specialist across the organization, supporting colleagues with treasury and finance-related questions. You will also contribute to managing banking relationships, funding activities, and the ongoing development of treasury operations and strategic initiatives.

**Our Culture

**We believe in freedom with responsibility. Our leadership style is built on trust, accountability, and collaboration. Team members are empowered to take ownership of their responsibilities while knowing support is always available when needed.

We also value a healthy work-life balance and strive to create an environment where people can perform at their best while maintaining flexibility and well-being.

**Why Join Us?

**This is an exciting career opportunity that will give you direct exposure to Executive Management in a listed company. You will have the opportunity to influence business decisions through insightful analysis, sound financial recommendations, and proactive risk management.

You will join an ambitious organization with a strong market position and a dynamic growth agenda. The role offers significant responsibility, professional challenges, and varied tasks within a highly capable and collaborative team. You will also build a broad network across the organization and benefit from excellent career and development opportunities.

**Your Profile

****We Are Looking For a Candidate Who Brings

**

• A minimum of 3 years of relevant experience within treasury, finance, banking, or a related field.

• A university degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, or a similar discipline (e.g., MSc in Finance, Economics, or equivalent).

• Strong analytical capabilities and a solid understanding of treasury processes and financial instruments.

• A commercial mindset with the ability to translate financial insights into practical business solutions.

• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

**In Addition, You

**

• Are advanced Excel user with a strong interest in financial systems and technology.

• Have experience with treasury management systems; SAP experience is considered an advantage.

• Are fluent in English, written and spoken.

**Personal Qualities

**You enjoy balancing deep analytical work with hands-on operational responsibilities and thrive in a role with broad organizational interaction. You are ambitious, curious, and confident in challenging established ways of working. At the same time, you bring positive energy, resilience, and a collaborative approach to your work.

**Does this sound like you?

**If you are motivated by combining analytical depth with business impact, and you thrive in a collaborative environment where ideas quickly turn into action, then you may be the colleague we're looking for. We look forward to receiving your application.

At Royal Unibrew, you'll find the industry's most dedicated, energetic, and experienced colleagues. Together, we build the best framework for a job that precisely matches your everyday life and career aspirations.

**Project Manager – Operations

****Location: Lyngby, Denmark

**Do you have a proven track record of turning complex operational challenges into tangible results? Are you motivated by getting close to manufacturing operations, analysing performance and working with teams to implement improvements that make a measurable difference?

We are looking for a Project Manager who combines strong analytical and problem-solving capability with the drive, resilience and hands-on approach required to deliver outcomes in complex manufacturing environments.

If you enjoy taking ownership, solving difficult problems and seeing your work translate into improved operational performance, this could be your next career move.

**The position

**As a Project Manager, you will work as part of our internal operations and manufacturing consulting team, delivering complex improvement, operational readiness and ramp up projects across our global manufacturing network.

This is not a traditional PMO or project coordination role.

You will be expected to get close to the operation, spend time on the shop floor, understand what is really happening within the production environment and use data and structured problem-solving to identify opportunities for improvement.

More importantly, your responsibility does not end when the solution has been identified. You will work alongside manufacturing teams and stakeholders to turn recommendations into actions and deliver tangible operational outcomes.

Our projects are typically intensive assignments, with project teams substantially dedicated to one project at a time. Assignments will often run for six to twelve months and can sometimes continue for longer.

**Your Key Responsibilities Will Include

**

• Taking ownership of project workstreams and operational improvement initiatives from diagnosis through to implementation and delivery.

• Driving operational readiness and ramp-up of new production lines, helping manufacturing operations achieve stable target performance.

• Working directly with manufacturing sites and shop-floor teams to understand operational challenges and identify bottlenecks, losses and improvement opportunities.

• Analysing operational performance data and developing capacity models, process maps and improvement scenarios.

• Translating complex analysis into clear recommendations, practical implementation roadmaps and measurable actions.

• Driving implementation and following improvements through to tangible operational outcomes.

• Working with production teams to establish sustainable changes in performance and ways of working.

• Collaborating with stakeholders across manufacturing, engineering, quality, supply chain and site leadership.

• Influencing stakeholders and maintaining momentum when implementation is challenging or priorities change.

• Communicating progress, risks, recommendations and outcomes clearly to relevant stakeholders and project leadership.

This is a hands on role. You should be comfortable moving between analytical problem-solving and the realities of implementation on the manufacturing shop floor.

The position is based in Lyngby, Denmark, and requires flexibility for up to 50% global travel.

Travel requirements will depend on project assignment and may change throughout a project. The ability and willingness to travel flexibly according to business and project requirements is therefore an essential requirement of the position.

**Qualifications

**We are looking for someone who can demonstrate a proven track record of delivering outcomes, rather than simply participating in projects.

You combine strong intellectual and analytical capability with the practical judgement, resilience and persistence required to turn ideas into results.

**To Succeed In This Role, You

**

• Hold a relevant degree in engineering, science, business administration, economics or another relevant discipline.

• Have relevant professional experience within areas such as manufacturing, operational excellence, operations consulting, engineering, supply chain, procurement or complex cross-functional project work.

• Can demonstrate a proven track record of taking ownership and delivering tangible outcomes through projects, operational improvements or complex cross-functional initiatives.

• Demonstrate strong analytical and structured problem-solving capability.

• Are comfortable personally analysing operational data and using it to identify performance gaps, bottlenecks and improvement opportunities.

• Can translate analysis into practical recommendations and then follow those recommendations through implementation.

• Are comfortable working hands-on with manufacturing sites and shop-floor teams.

• Can operate effectively in complex and ambiguous environments where the solution may not initially be obvious.

• Demonstrate strong stakeholder management, collaboration and communication skills.

• Have the resilience and persistence to continue driving change when implementation is difficult or initial solutions do not deliver the expected results.

• Are professionally proficient in English.

• Are able and willing to travel globally for up to 50% of your time according to project requirements.

Relevant experience from operations or management consulting can be particularly valuable, including experience gained within operational practices or projects.

We are also interested in candidates from complex manufacturing environments such as pharmaceuticals, automotive, aerospace and FMCG, particularly where you have worked with operational improvement, production ramp-up, manufacturing performance or Lean ways of working.

Pharmaceutical manufacturing, GMP and validation experience are advantageous but are not essential.

Experience working within a Lean manufacturing environment can also be beneficial. Formal Lean certification is not required.

Likewise, formal project management qualifications such as PMP or PRINCE2 are not a requirement. We place greater emphasis on your demonstrated ability to structure problems, work with people, take ownership and deliver measurable outcomes.

**About The Department

**You will join Drug Product Manufacturing Excellence, a global unit responsible for driving performance improvements, operational readiness and transformation across Novo's manufacturing network.

The team operates as an internal operations and manufacturing consultancy, supporting our manufacturing organisation with complex operational challenges.

Our colleagues bring diverse professional backgrounds, including operations and management consulting, Novo manufacturing and support functions, and industries such as automotive, aerospace and FMCG.

What brings the team together is the ability to combine analytical problem-solving with hands-on implementation.

Our projects can include operational readiness and ramp-up of new production lines, improving capacity and performance within existing operations and solving complex cross-functional manufacturing challenges.

Rather than managing several projects simultaneously, our project teams are typically substantially dedicated to one assignment, allowing them to work closely with the operation and remain involved from diagnosis through to implementation.

As a Project Manager, you will have meaningful ownership within these assignments and will be expected to demonstrate that your work ultimately translates into operational outcomes.

The role provides significant exposure to different manufacturing environments, functions and senior stakeholders across our global organisation and offers opportunities to progress towards increasingly complex project and leadership responsibilities.

**Working at Novo

**Every day we seek the solutions that defeat serious chronic diseases. To do this, we approach our work with determination, constant curiosity and a commitment to finding better ways forward. For over 100 years, this dedication has driven us to build a company focused on lasting change for long-term health. One where diverse thinking, shared purpose and mutual respect come together to create extraordinary results. When you join us, you're not just starting a job – you're becoming part of a story that spans generations.

**What We Offer

**There is, of course, more on offer here than the uniqueness of our culture and the extraordinary results we produce. Being part of a global healthcare company means opportunities to learn and develop are all around us, while our benefits are designed with your career and life stage in mind.

**Salary And Benefits

**Salary: For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 651,000 to 956,900 DKK, corresponding to the level of the position.

The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate's skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

**Incentives And Benefits

**The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks.

**More information

**Please apply in English and refrain from adding a photo to your CV to ensure fair and efficient processing.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

At Novo, we recognise that it is no longer good enough to aspire to be the best company in the world. We need to aspire to be the best company for the world and we know that this is only possible with talented employees with diverse perspectives, backgrounds and cultures. We are therefore committed to creating an inclusive culture that celebrates the diversity of our employees, the patients we serve and communities we operate in. Together, we're life changing.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

**Minimum qualifications:

**

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

• Experience in diagnosing and troubleshooting operating systems and computer/server hardware or networking protocols.

• Experience with performing component-level repairs on IT equipment.

• Ability to lift/move 50lb (23kg) of equipment and to exert physically over extended periods of time, including frequent bending, kneeling, climbing, pushing/pulling and lifting.

**

• Certification in online Google IT Support Professional Certificate program.

• 2 years of experience in diagnosing and troubleshooting operating systems and computer/server hardware or networking protocols.

• Experience in working within a data center or network operation center environment.

• Ability to collaborate and partner with teams to overcome tests.

• Ability to adapt to changes in a changing work environment.

**About The Job

**Google isn't just a software company. The Hardware Operations team is responsible for monitoring the state-of-the-art physical infrastructure behind Google's powerful search technology. As an Operations Technician, you'll install, configure, test, troubleshoot and maintain hardware (like servers and its components) and server software (like Google's Linux cluster). You'll also take on the configuration of more complex components such as networks, routers, hubs, bridges, switches and networking protocols. You'll participate in or lead small project teams on larger installations and develop project contingency plans. A typical day involves manual movement and installation of racks, and while it can sometimes be physically demanding, you are excited to work with infrastructure that is at the cutting-edge of computer technology.

Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.

Are you an experienced upstream Principal Technician with a solid understanding of mammalian cell culture processes, from thaw to harvest? Do you enjoy taking responsibility for production activities while sharing your experience with colleagues?

At AGC Biologics in Søborg, we are looking for a Principal Technician to join our Mammalian Upstream Manufacturing team for a nine-month maternity cover.

You will become part of a team of eight, including your supervisor, working in a dynamic, GMP-regulated environment where different products and customer requirements call for technical understanding, adaptability, and attention to detail.

About The Job

As a Principal Technician, you will contribute to the execution of mammalian upstream manufacturing processes, ensuring that production activities are performed safely, efficiently, and in compliance with GMP requirements.

The role combines hands-on production work with independent responsibility, technical understanding, and close collaboration with your colleagues.

Your Main Responsibilities Will Include

• Preparing media and performing aseptic handling of mammalian cell cultures in a laminar airflow (LAF) bench.

• Setting up single-use manufacturing equipment, including wave rockers and bioreactors ranging from 200 L to 2,000 L.

• Performing daily sampling of cell cultures, feed additions, harvest, and clarification activities.

• Ensuring accurate and timely GMP documentation and compliance with approved procedures and aseptic practices.

• Supporting troubleshooting, deviation investigations, and continuous improvement activities.

• Taking ownership of your training and technical qualifications while sharing knowledge and providing practical guidance to colleagues when relevant.

Who Are We Looking For?

We Imagine That You

• Ideally have an educational background as a Process Operator, Process Technologist, Biotechnology Technician, or an equivalent relevant technical qualification.

• Have approximately 3–5 years of experience in GMP-regulated manufacturing, preferably within biopharmaceutical production.

• Have a solid understanding of mammalian cell culture processes, from thaw to harvest.

• Have practical experience with upstream manufacturing equipment and processes, preferably in a GMP-regulated biopharmaceutical environment.

• Are familiar with GMP requirements, aseptic practices, and accurate production documentation.

• Can independently execute manufacturing activities and contribute to solving operational challenges.

• Are fluent in written and spoken English.

Beyond your technical experience, we value colleagues who take ownership of their work, maintain high standards of quality, and contribute positively to the team.

You work in a structured way, adapt to changing production needs, and willingly share your knowledge. You communicate openly and know when to ask for support or escalate an issue rather than compromise quality or compliance.

The position follows a 5-2 day-shift rotation, with working hours from 06:00–17:04.

What We Offer

At AGC Biologics, you will join an international biopharmaceutical manufacturing environment where technical expertise, accountability, quality, and teamwork are central to how we work.

We Offer

• The opportunity to work with mammalian upstream processes and different manufacturing setups, applying and developing your technical expertise.

• A role where your experience matters, both in daily production and in supporting your colleagues.

• A supportive and approachable manager who values quality, accountability, and open communication.

• A close-knit team where knowledge sharing, collaboration, and continuous improvement are encouraged.

• Access to our canteen arrangement, Employee Club, and employee discount opportunities.

Interested?

If you have experience with mammalian upstream manufacturing and are motivated by combining technical responsibility with quality and teamwork, we would like to hear from you.

Please submit your application and CV through our recruitment system. Applications will be reviewed continuously, and we reserve the right to close the job posting once we have found the right candidate.

Who We Are

AGC Biologics is a global Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization with a strong presence in Denmark. From our Søborg site, we develop and manufacture life‑changing advanced biologics for some of the world’s most innovative pharmaceutical companies. Together with our team members across Europe, the U.S., and Japan, we deliver development and manufacturing of mammalian and microbial-based therapeutic proteins, plasmid DNA (pDNA), messenger RNA (mRNA), viral vectors, and genetically engineered cells therapies. Across our global network, we are united by one mission: To work side by side with our customers in order to improve patients’ lives by bringing new biopharmaceuticals to market.

At Genmab, we are dedicated to building extra[not]ordinary® futures, together, by developing antibody products and groundbreaking, knock-your-socks-off KYSO antibody medicines® that change lives and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. We strive to create, champion and maintain a global workplace where individuals’ unique contributions are valued and drive innovative solutions to meet the needs of our patients, care partners, families and employees.

Our people are compassionate, candid, and purposeful, and our business is innovative and rooted in science. We believe that being proudly authentic and determined to be our best is essential to fulfilling our purpose. Yes, our work is incredibly serious and impactful, but we have big ambitions, bring a ton of care to pursuing them, and have a lot of fun while doing so.

Does this inspire you and feel like a fit? Then we would love to have you join us!

At Genmab, we’re committed to building extra[not]ordinary futures together, by developing antibody products and pioneering, knock-your-socks-off therapies that change the lives of patients and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. From our people who are caring, candid, and impact-driven to our business, which is innovative and rooted in science, we believe that being proudly unique, determined to be our best, and authentic is essential to fulfilling our purpose.

**The Role and Department

**The Late Stage CMC Project organization is growing and we are looking for 2 Directors to lead and develop a team of Project Managers in Genmab’s late-stage CMC project organization.

The roles have similar responsibility and you will combine people leadership with strategic oversight and hands-on responsibility for complex CMC programs, including contribution to governance of outsourced activities with contract development and manufacturing organizations (CDMOs).

Both postions report to the Senior Director, Head of the Late-Stage Project Management Office, within Genmab Tech Ops in Denmark. Working closely with CMC, Regulatory Affairs, Quality and Supply Chain, you will align CMC delivery with development priorities and drive progress towards regulatory submission and commercial readiness.

You will help shape the late-stage project organization, develop experienced Project Managers and translate portfolio priorities into clear decisions and reliable delivery.

**Responsibilities

**Team leadership and development

• Lead and develop your team through resource planning, recruitment, performance management and succession planning, building capabilities for current and future portfolio needs

• Coach Project Managers in strategic thinking, cross-functional leadership and resolving complex CMC challenges. Set clear expectations, delegate effectively and build accountability for results

• Work closely with the Senior Director to prioritize resources and budgets across the team’s programs, resolve capacity constraints and align delivery with portfolio objectives

CMC strategy and project responsibilities

• Shape CMC strategies with technical and functional leads, aligned with overall Drug Development Plans. Lead assigned programs through integrated planning, budget analysis and management of cross-program dependencies.

• Drive cross-functional delivery of technology transfer, process validation, manufacturing readiness and submission documentation, with clear ownership and adherence to Genmab’s quality system and applicable regulatory requirements

• Ensure reliable plans, risk and decision logs, and executive reporting. Anticipate portfolio impacts, resolve high-impact issues and facilitate data-driven options and recommendations to senior governance forums

• Lead improvements to the Project Manual, governance and ways of working, including digital and AI-enabled tools that strengthen planning, risk management and delivery

**CDMO collaboration and project governance

**

• Representing Late Stage CMC Project Management in CDMO joint project and steering committees, facilitating strategic discussions and decisions within delegated authority. Ensure decisions translate into clear commitments and follow-through

• Shape outsourcing and partnership strategies with relevant functions, aligning proposals, contracts and quality agreements with program objectives, business needs and intellectual property considerations

• Hold partners accountable for agreed scope, quality, timelines and budgets. Build transparent relationships, resolve vendor conflicts and escalate strategic trade-offs and risks with clear recommendations

**Requirements

**

• Master’s degree or higher in natural sciences, pharmacy, engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent experience

• Extensive biopharmaceutical CMC experience, including late-stage biologics development and progression towards commercial supply. Experience with antibody-drug conjugates is an advantage

• Proven experience shaping strategies and leading complex global CMC programs, including portfolio prioritization, strategic budget management and cross-functional risk resolution

• Established people-leadership experience, with a track record of developing Project Managers, building team capabilities and supporting talent and succession planning

• Strong understanding of technology transfer, process validation, submission strategies and the interdependencies between development, manufacturing and supply

• Experience shaping outsourcing strategies, leading CDMO governance and resolving complex partner issues with sound business judgment

• Advanced knowledge of GMP and global CMC regulatory expectations, including those relevant to FDA, EMA and NMPA submissions

• Excellent English communication skills, with a track record of influencing senior stakeholders and translating complex issues into clear business recommendations.

**About You

**You combine strategic perspective with the judgment to know when to engage directly and when to empower others. You develop people, set clear priorities and make well-founded decisions under uncertainty, balancing quality, timelines and cost.

You build trust across functions and cultures, challenge assumptions constructively and create an inclusive environment where colleagues take ownership. You champion a ONE-Team approach, welcome feedback and turn lessons learned into improvements across the project organization.

**Location and Travel

**The role is based in Denmark. Travel is expected to be approximately 10–15 days per year.

Genmab leverages the effectiveness of an agile working environment, when possible, for the betterment of employee work-life balance. Our offices are designed as open, community-based spaces that work to connect our employees. Whether you’re in one of our collaboratively designed office spaces or working remotely, we thrive on connecting with each other to innovate.

The proposed gross annual/hourly base salary range for this position, in the primary location, based on a full time schedule is:

DKK883.200,00---1.324.800,00

The final salary offer will depend on several factors, including your skills, qualifications, and experience.

In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as discretionary bonuses and long-term incentives.

**Benefits

**When you join Genmab, you become a part of a culture that supports your physical, financial, social, and emotional well-being. Our benefits include, but are not limited to:

• Pension

• Health insurance and wellness benefits

• Paid time off

• Employee support programs

Further details on eligibility for compensation and benefits based on the role will be provided during the recruitment process.

**About Genmab

**Genmab is an international biotechnology company with a core purpose to improve the lives of patients through innovative and differentiated antibody therapeutics. For 25 years, its hard-working, innovative and collaborative team has invented next-generation antibody technology platforms and harnessed translational, quantitative and data sciences, resulting in a proprietary pipeline including bispecific T-cell engagers, antibody-drug conjugates, next-generation immune checkpoint modulators and effector function-enhanced antibodies. By 2030, Genmab’s vision is to transform the lives of people with cancer and other serious diseases with Knock-Your-Socks-Off (KYSO®) antibody medicines.

Established in 1999, Genmab is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark with international presence across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific. For more information, please visit Genmab.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Genmab is committed to protecting your personal data and privacy. Please see our privacy policy for handling your data in connection with your application on our website Job Applicant Privacy Notice (genmab.com).

jobs.occupation: Business Consultant, Investment, Netcompany Banking Services
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about IT, business, and finance? As a Business Consultant, you will specialise in banking and investment, collaborating with clients and experienced colleagues to design IT solutions and develop expertise in investment processes and corporate actions.

Netcompany Banking Services

We deliver various IT solutions and services to banks and savings institutions across Denmark and other Nordic countries. We provide a modern, cloud-based core banking platform serving more than 50 Nordic banks with over 2 million end customers. Our solutions encompass daily banking operations, mobile and internet banking, payments, investment management, risk management, compliance, and open banking.

Responsibilities

We are looking for a Business Consultant with an interest in digitalisation and financial services to support initiatives within banking and investment. You will contribute to analysing business needs, mapping processes, and designing IT solutions in close collaboration with clients and colleagues. An interest in or basic knowledge of investment-related processes is an advantage.

You will join a team of highly experienced professionals who will support your continuous development towards a role as subject matter expert within IT solutions for banking and investment. Over time, you will build deep domain knowledge and develop into a go-to within banking and investment solutions.

Your responsibilities will typically include:

• 
Analysing clients' business needs and translating and formulating requirements into IT solutions within the banking and investment domain.

• 
Mapping business processes and facilitating workshops with clients to identify needs, challenges, and opportunities for optimisation.

• 
Supporting the analysis and design of solutions related to investment processes.

• 
Collaborating with experienced colleagues and clients on solution design, testing, refinement, and implementation, while supporting user involvement, training, and change management where relevant.

• 
Building domain knowledge through hands-on project experience and knowledge sharing, with the opportunity to develop into a subject matter expert over time.

About you

You actively seek understanding by asking questions and encourage learning through curiosity and dialogue. You enjoy understanding how business processes work and how IT can support and improve them. Deadlines do not intimidate you, and you are willing to go the extra mile when needed. To succeed in this role, you:

• 
Are either a recent graduate or have a few years of experience, ideally working at the intersection of IT and business. Most importantly you are motivated to build specialized domain knowledge.

• 
Hold a relevant master's degree, such as Cand.merc. IT, Cand.it., or a similar degree with a focus on the intersection of finance and IT.

• 
Have a genuine interest in IT and digitalisation, preferably combined with an interest in finance, banking, investment, or financial services.

• 
Have an interest in or basic experience with investment-related processes, such as corporate actions. Previous experience within banking or investment is an advantage, but not a requirement.

• 
Full professional proficiency in Danish and English (written and spoken) is a must

Join an inclusive community

At Netcompany, we highly prioritise an inclusive community. We actively promote an open and welcoming work culture based on collaboration and mutual trust, where there is always an opportunity for sparring.

As part of our culture and values, all employees, regardless of background, identity, and experience, are met with understanding and respect and given equal opportunities for development and well-being.

As we are an international company with offices in many countries, you will have the opportunity to learn and collaborate internationally with colleagues from across the world. We offer a shared environment where we engage with each other across departments and projects. Additionally, we have a wide range of social and professional events that provide you with the best opportunities to expand and build a network early in your career.

Send us your application

Upload your resume and a motivational letter to our recruitment system via the link. If you have unanswered questions, feel free to write to hr.dk@netcompany.com.

All qualified candidates are encouraged to apply regardless of gender, gender expression, sexuality, disability, age, religion and belief, political views, nationality, ethnicity, or social background.

We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse environment. Our recruitment processes are based on individual merit. If you require any reasonable adjustments or additional support during the interview process, please email our recruiters at reasonableadjustments@netcompany.com for assistance.

At Trustpilot, we're on an incredible journey. We're a profitable, high-growth FTSE-250 company with a big vision: to become the universal symbol of trust. You will work closely with cross-functional and commercial teams to ensure the tools are utilised to their full potential, driving productivity and performance across our sales organisation.

What you'll be doing:

• Develop, deliver, and maintain comprehensive training programs for Salesforce and commercial tools tailored to various roles and user groups within the organisation.

• Create engaging materials, including documentation, tutorials, videos, and webinars.

• Conduct onboarding sessions for new hires and ongoing training for existing staff to reinforce best practices.

• Partner with the Operational Excellence team and other stakeholders to identify areas for improvement in how tools are used.

• Work closely with sales managers, customer success teams, and operations to align tool training with strategic goals.

• Strong understanding of sales processes and customer success workflows.

• Central office with a laid-back vibe and constant buzz of different languages being spoken everywhere you go It’s complete with a coffee bar, canteen, and table tennis and has a wide variety of refreshments available - you can opt-in for breakfast and lunch at an affordable price

• Regular opportunities to connect and get to know your fellow Trusties, including company-wide celebrations and events, ERG activities, and team socials

• Opportunity to join the Trustpilot Social Club for a small monthly fee and attend regular social and leisure activities like go-karting, cooking classes, and escape rooms

Still not sure?

We want to be a part of creating a more diverse, equitable, and inclusive world of work for all. We’re excited to hear about your experiences along with how you will contribute to our working culture. Even if you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, we'd still really like to hear from you!

About us

Trustpilot began in 2007 with a simple yet powerful idea that is more relevant today than ever — to be the universal symbol of trust, bringing consumers and businesses together through reviews. Trustpilot is open, independent, and impartial — we help consumers make the right choices and businesses to build trust, grow and improve.

Today, we have more than 300 million reviews and 64 million monthly active users on average across the globe, with 140 billion annual Trustbox impressions, and the numbers keep growing. We have more than 1,000 employees and we’re headquartered in Copenhagen, with operations in Amsterdam, Denver, Edinburgh, Hamburg, London, Melbourne, Milan and New York.

We’re driven by connection. It’s at the heart of what we do. Our culture keeps things fresh –– it’s built on the relationships we create. We talk, we laugh, we collaborate and we respect each other. We work across borders and cultures to be the universal symbol of trust in an ever-changing world. With vibrant office locations worldwide and over 50 nationalities, we’re proud to be an equal opportunity workplace with diverse perspectives and ideas.

Our purpose to help people and businesses help each other is a tall order, but we keep it real. We’re a great bunch of humans, doing awesome stuff, without fuss or pretense. A successful Trustpilot future is driven by you –– we give you the autonomy to shape a career you can be proud of. If you’re ready to grow, let’s go.

Join us at the heart of trust.

Trustpilot is committed to creating an inclusive environment where people from all backgrounds can thrive and where different viewpoints and experiences are valued and respected. Trustpilot will consider all applications for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, national origin, religious beliefs, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, neurodiversity, disability, age, parental or veteran status. Together, we are the heart of trust.

_Trustpilot is a global company and our data practices are designed to ensure that your personally identifiable information is appropriately protected. Please note that your personal information will be transferred, accessed, and stored globally as necessary for the uses and disclosures stated in our Privacy Policy.

If you have a disability and would like to discuss any adjustments you might need either in submitting your application, or to the recruitment process more generally, please let us know by contacting our Talent Acquisition Team (talent.acquisition@trustpilot.com)  quoting the role you wish to apply for._

**Our Purpose

**Planday from Xero is a leading digital solution that uncomplicates everyday scheduling and workforce management by making it easier for businesses and shift workers around the world to communicate, collaborate, and get work done.

Powered by a community of local industry experts, Planday provides a best-in-class digital platform that is easy to use, accurate, secure, and compliant with local needs and standards. From payroll and accounting to POS and reporting, its open API and tech ecosystem is scalable to fit shifting business needs and to build an engaged, flexible workforce.

Founded in 2004, Planday is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark and supports over 400,000 users across Europe, Australia and the US. Planday was acquired by Xero in 2021.

**How You’ll Make An Impact

**As our Lead Engineer- Data, you will set the architectural direction of the data platform that enables both the decisions we make internally and the data-driven features our customers rely on. Working with the Data, ML, Platform, and Product Engineering teams, you will keep ingestion, modelling, and orchestration dependable, and define the modelling, testing, and documentation standards the data function depends on. You will innovate on how people work with data, building the agentic tooling and semantic modelling that let teams across Planday work from trusted data with confidence.

**What You’ll Do

**

• Set the architectural direction of our data platform so it serves analytics, product engineering, and AI/ML from one coherent design, collaborating with Platform and ML engineering on shared infrastructure.

• Design the dbt models, semantic layer, and quality standards the data function depends on, with the validation and lineage to make them trustworthy downstream.

• Own orchestration and observability in Dagster, and onboarding new sources in a way that scales.

• Innovate on self-serve and AI-enabled analytics, from semantic models and agentic workflows to our BI layer.

• Build the historical and low-latency foundations that make predictive and real-time use cases possible.

• Introduce better modelling standards, tooling, and development environments.

• Keep the platform reliable, performant, cost-effective, and compliant.

**Success looks like

**

• Architecture that holds up as we scale and as new use cases emerge, and that other engineers follow as a pattern.

• Analysts ship faster and more efficiently because your tooling & standards remove friction.

• A drop in repeat requests to the data team, as stakeholders answer their own questions through agentic workflows.

• ML and product teams have the historical and real-time data they need, without bespoke workarounds.

• Strong working relationships with the Data, ML, and Platform teams.

**What You’ll Bring With You

**

• Deep, hands-on Snowflake and dbt experience: modelling, semantic layers, agents & skills, testing, performance and cost tuning.

• Production experience with a pipeline orchestrator, ideally Dagster (or similar Airflow, Prefect), including dependent workloads, partial failures, and observability.

• Modern cloud infrastructure (Azure/AWS/GCP) and Kubernetes experience deploying and operating containerised workloads, plus infrastructure as code (Terraform).

• Strong SQL & Python for pipelines, services, and automation.

• Software engineering discipline across CI/CD, testing, and code review.

• The ability to turn technical trade-offs into clear narratives that help stakeholders decide and trust the work.

• Experience operating data systems, including incident response, cost, and data privacy practices.

**At Planday, we offer you

**

• Benefits like pension, health insurance, inclusive support for new parents and generous vacation

• On top of your annual base salary, you are offered to be part of an Employee Share Plan

• Growth and progression opportunities – we want you to grow with us

• Flexible remote work

• Strong social culture with lots of team and company activities

• Meaningful work – everyone at Planday contributes to improving the lives of shift workers around the globe

• Healthy work-life balance and autonomous approach to work. We trust in you and your abilities

Finally, our offices are not just workplaces (although they are pretty nice and well-located, we have to say!). Plandayers are open and welcoming and at Planday, everyone has the freedom and support to show their true self at work.

_At Planday, we firmly believe that diversity and inclusion are the cornerstones of innovation and a vibrant workplace culture. As an equal opportunity employer, we strive to create an equitable experience for all candidates throughout the process. Please let us know if you need any reasonable adjustments during the application or interview process.

jobs.occupation: Business Controller - Drive Financial Insight and Business Performance
jobs.description:
Join us as a Business Controller

Are you passionate about turning complex information into clear business insights? Do you enjoy asking questions, challenging assumptions and investigating unexpected trends to understand the business behind the numbers, not just reporting them?

We are looking for a skilled and business-oriented Business Controller to join our Finance & Controlling team. This is a full-time role based in Copenhagen, structured as a hybrid position that combines office presence with some work-from-home flexibility.

What is the job about?

As a Business Controller, you will be much more than the owner of reports and forecasts. You will act as a trusted business partner, helping our management team understand what is happening in the business, why it is happening and what we should do next.

You will work across our insurance operations in Denmark, Sweden and Norway, partnering closely with colleagues in Claims, Sales, Underwriting, Operations, Finance, IT and other business functions to improve business performance. Through high-quality financial controlling, analysis and reporting, you will provide reliable insights and ensure transparency, accuracy and compliance.

Your qualifications

• Experience in Business Controlling, FP&A or another finance business partnering role is required.

• Strong analytical and commercial mindset, with experience analysing business performance.

• Experience with or understanding of budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis and business planning.

• Ability to communicate complex financial topics clearly to non-financial stakeholders.

• Experience with Excel and BI tools, combined with the ability to use AI effectively

• Familiarity with ERP (e.g. SAP GT) systems is an advantage

• Experience working with large datasets and translating analysis into business recommendations.

• Strong organisational skills and ability to manage multiple priorities.

• Relevant degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration or a related discipline.

What will make you successful?

You’ll probably enjoy this role if you:

• Are genuinely curious about how businesses work.

• You are motivated by understanding complexity.

• Like asking “Why?” until you reach the root cause.

• You remain optimistic and persistent despite struggles.

• You like solving new problems along with routine tasks.

• Are comfortable making decisions without having every answer upfront.

• Build relationships across functions because you know the best insights rarely come from spreadsheets alone.

• Have the confidence to challenge assumptions, supported by facts rather than opinions.

• Take pride in helping others make better decisions through data and insight.

What we offer?

We offer an exciting opportunity to join a professional and collaborative finance environment where you can make a tangible impact on business performance.

You will have the opportunity to:

• Work with complex financial and business-related challenges

• Collaborate with experienced professionals across local and central / headquarter functions

• Contribute to the continuous improvement of reporting, planning, and governance processes

• Further develop your technical expertise and business understanding

• Play an active role in supporting strategic and operational decision-making

If you are motivated by financial analysis, business partnering, and continuous improvement, we would love to hear from you.

Location: Copenhagen, Denmark

Department: Finance & Controlling

Reporting to: Head of Controlling

How to apply

If you would like to know more about the position, you are welcome to contact:

Edgards Baumanis

Nordic Head of Controlling

Email: Edgars.Baumanis@ergo.dk

If this sounds like the right opportunity for you, please send your CV and application to hr@ergo.dk

We look forward to hearing from you!

Who we are

ERGO Forsikring A/S is one of the leading insurance companies in the Nordic region, formed through the merger of Europæiske Rejseforsikring A/S and ERGO Forsikring AS. The company provides health and travel insurance solutions in Denmark, Norway and Sweden. In Denmark, travel insurance is offered under the Europæiske ERV brand, which has more than 100 years of experience in safeguarding travellers, while health insurance is delivered to businesses under the ERGO Forsikring brand.

ERGO Forsikring A/S is part of ERGO Group AG, a major international insurance group and the primary insurance arm of Munich Re. You will join an organisation with strong regional roots and global backing, focused on reliability, customer security and long-term partnerships.

Directure is an international management consulting firm devoted to advising and assisting organisations within life science, healthcare and other regulated industries, to realise their strategy aspirations. We operate through an integrated approach to consulting, combining best practice standards and disciplines of Management Consulting, International Search and People Resource Consulting. Today, Directure advises a variety of companies that seek guidance and counselling on business and senior leadership needs with an increasing access to executives around the world. We combine the in-depth expertise of an international advisor with the focus and flexibility of a boutique consulting firm that has put impact above size.

Team Assistant

The Role

Directure's consultants run complex, multi-client advisory practices. They need someone close — someone who keeps the operational side running with precision while also contributing to the polished outputs clients receive.

The role is onsite and sits at the intersection of those characteristics. You will own the administrative infrastructure that keeps consultants effective — diary management, travel, planning, correspondence — and you will contribute directly to client deliverables: communications, reports and advanced PowerPoint presentations built to a consulting standard.

Responsibilities

Two distinct, equally important areas of work

Administration & Coordination

• Own and manage complex partner and consultant diaries — scheduling, sequencing, and protecting time for deep work

• Plan and coordinate all travel: flights, accommodation, ground logistics, and changes in the field

• Prepare meeting agendas, briefing notes, and follow-up actions; manage correspondence independently where appropriate

• Track project timelines, upcoming milestones, and internal team deadlines across active engagements

• Administrative coordination with Finance.

• Maintain organised filing systems and document libraries for ongoing project matters

• Build and maintain advanced PowerPoint presentations — slide logic, visual hierarchy, data visualisation — to a standard appropriate for senior client audiences. Assist in preparing pitch materials, proposals, and thought-leadership content

• Quality-check outputs before client delivery: language, consistency, and visual finish

What We're Looking For

Skills, background, and ways of working

• An academic degree and + 2 years of FTE experience in a professional services, consulting, corporate, or equivalent environment — you understand what high-standard output looks like

• Strong PowerPoint skills are essential: you can build a structured, visually coherent presentation from a brief, not just populate a template

• Organised in a way that holds under pressure: priorities shift, deadlines accelerate, and you adapt without dropping things

• Excellent written communication in English – native or proficiency; your drafts need minimal editing before they go out

• Proficiency in Microsoft 365 and quick to learn tools you haven't used before

• Discreet and professional in your handling of sensitive information; you understand what confidentiality means in a client-facing environment

• Curious about the work itself — you want to understand the engagements you're supporting, not just manage the calendar around them

The remuneration reflects your qualifications.

How to Apply

Please send your CV and a brief cover letter under reference "TA" to career@directure.com. Please note that we will invite, interview and select among candidates on an ongoing basis. We look forward to receiving your application, which will be treated in strictest confidence.

For more information about Directure please visit: www.directure.com

The Impact You'll Make

Join our two-year Graduate Program and become part of a team that turns ideas into real impact. You will contribute to business-critical projects, work across functions and develop an understanding of how a global industrial company operates. From day one, you’ll take on meaningful challenges, bring your perspective to complex problems and help create smarter, more sustainable solutions for people and the planet.

How The Program Works

Starting 1 September 2027, you’ll complete three 8-month rotations, building functional expertise, strengthening your project and collaboration skills and exploring where you can contribute most. Your journey starts at our headquarters in Nordborg or Graasten, Denmark and continues in regions such as the USA, Asia or Europe.

You’ll work in cross-functional teams - from office spaces to production floors -, gaining a full picture of how global business, innovation and sustainability connect at Danfoss.

After completing the program, you’ll be well prepared to take on future opportunities - potentially moving into a permanent role at Danfoss that aligns with your strengths, ambitions and career path.

What You’ll Be Doing

• Take ownership of projects across functions like Engineering, Sales or Operations & Supply Chain.

• Collaborate and implement solutions with experts, mentors and peers from all over the world.

• Analyze problems and translate findings into practical improvements.

• Learn fast, challenge the status quo and shape the future of Danfoss.

What We're Looking For

• A Master’s degree in Engineering (mechanical, electrical, industrial, or mechatronics), Supply Chain or Economics with graduation in 2026 or 2027.

• Recently graduated, with a maximum of two years of full-time professional work experience after graduation.

• Communicate confidently in English, both written and spoken.

• Enjoy learning, exploring new ideas and improving how things work.

• Work well across cultures and value inclusion, teamwork and respect.

• Have experience from an internship or student project.

What You'll Get From Us

• Learning & Mentoring: You’ll have a dedicated mentor, a buddy, project-based learning and structured workshops to understand the business.

• Global Opportunities: Experience diverse cultures, build your international network and discover your best-fit career path.

• Flexibility & Well-being: We support balance, trust and autonomy so you can do your best work and take care of yourself.

• Inclusive Culture: Be part of a workplace where you can bring your whole self -your background, ideas and ambitions all matter.

• Competitive Benefits: You’ll receive a fair, transparent compensation package including paid vacation, pension, personal insurance. Don’t worry about the move to Denmark, we offer a relocation package, accommodation support and more - details vary by country.

Ready to Make a Difference?

If this program excites you, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply between 2 November 2026 and 18 December 2026.

Don’t meet every single requirement? That’s okay - potential matters more than perfection.

If you’re curious, motivated and ready to grow, we encourage you to apply.

Our Commitment to Transparency

Salary ranges listed reflect only primary location and currency. For local salary ranges and specific benefits in your preferred hiring location, please ask your Talent Acquisition representative for more information.

The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Any benefits listed do not promise or guarantee any particular benefit or specific action. They may depend on country or contract specifics and are subject to change at any time without prior notice.

Want to know more? Please visit our FAQ Page.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or other protected category.

Netcompany Banking Services

jobs.occupation: Administrative Coordinator for Post fixture assistance in Bioenergy
jobs.description:
Join us in this role where you’ll be part of a department handling more than 550 import vessels and 25,000 biomass truck deliveries annually to our power plants across Denmark. Our team ensures that our power plants always have the feedstock they need, enabling Ørsted to deliver heat and power to local communities. Looking ahead, logistics will also play a significant role in the transportation of CO₂, adding an exciting new dimension to our responsibilities. We work cross-departmental in the company with e.g. Fuel Procurement, Back Office, Finance and Sustainability who all rely on our swift, accurate and efficient support.

**Welcome to Bioenergy - Customers & Markets

**You’ll be part of Shipping & Logistics where you, together with your colleagues, will contribute to respective areas of expertise when needed. In-depth SAP knowledge, confidence in creating and managing purchase orders, and the ability to handle fast-track payments are important parts of the role. Strong Excel skills and a competitive commercial mindset is essential. Knowledge and experience within shipping and logistics is a clear advantage, and you must be able to read and understand contracts, to ensure operations are carried out in accordance with the agreed terms. As a team, we are six colleagues with a flat organizational structure, where collaboration, trust, flexibility and a willingness to help one another are essential to how we work.

**You’ll play an important role in:

**

• providing fundamental input and improvement suggestions to enhance efficiency and optimize processes incl. preparing and developing PowerPoint presentations for internal and external use

• contributing to the continued growth of Bioenergy and supporting the department’s commercial and operational activities

• acting as the department’s SAP expert, requiring in-depth knowledge and understanding of relevant SAP processes and functionalities

• independently creating and maintaining purchase orders and ensuring accurate and timely administration

• performing post-fixture activities, including laytime calculations, port turnaround figures for both own and external vessels, and tonnage reporting

• collaborating, both verbally and in writing in Danish and English, with shipowners, operators, brokers, surveyors, truck haulers and other external partners, as well as colleagues across the Orsted organization.

**To succeed in the role, you:

**

• are a Team player and at the same time strive working independently

• laugh easily and appreciate an informal tone and further more you possess curiosity and willingness to learn

• love fast pace at work and are not afraid of being challenged even though it might be out of your comfortzone

• possess a thorough practical knowledge of SAP and Excel

• think and act commercially and know how to calculate in days, hours and minutes (laytime)

• see yourself growing as the position is a natural stepping stone towards a Logistics Coordinator role, where you gradually will take on more responsibility and a broader range of independent tasks.

Maybe you’ve read the above and can see you have some transferable skills, even though they don’t quite match all the points. If you think you can bring something to the team, we still encourage you to apply.

**Shape the future with us

**Send your application and CV to us as soon as possible. We’ll be conducting interviews on a continuous basis and reserve the right to take down the advert when we’ve found the right candidate.

As an applicant or employee, you may request reasonable work and position accommodation or adjustments via accommodation@orsted.com.

Please note that for your application to be taken into consideration, you must submit your application via our online career pages and answer the screening questions relevant for your country. We don't take applications or inquiries from external recruiters or agencies into account for this position.

**For this position, the expected base pay range is according to collective agreement relevant for the advertised location. The offered base salary will be determined within this range based on relevant skills, experience, and expected role fulfilment within the stated pay range to ensure a fair and competitive offer. Where applicable, you may also be eligible for variable payment and a comprehensive benefits package.

**For this position, employees who meet eligibility requirements have access to: employer‑paid pension (11% contribution), full insurance coverage (accident, life, critical illness, and health insurance); five weeks of paid holiday plus 10 additional paid days off per holiday year; a 3% holiday allowance; access to Ørsted Life & Fitness Vitality including fitness classes, physiotherapy, massage, and wellbeing programmes; a multimedia package (mobile phone, PC, internet); staff club membership with sport and cultural activities; and access to the company canteen (monthly lunch scheme or daily tickets).

**Certain positions may require a background check as part of the hiring process. If applicable, you will be informed during the recruitment process. Background checks are conducted by an external provider in accordance with local legal requirements.

• The ability to explain complex issues clearly in English and work effectively with technical and functional colleagues.
